title: 第5章 一个糟老头子听说他以前很能打第6章 义顺堂三堂主吴忠义
slug: 我武举人晚年才来武学修改器
content_zh:
二楼听到三楼动静，楼梯口也传来杂乱的脚步声和吆喝，更多的毒蛇帮帮众涌了上来。
转眼间就将陆家带来的百余名打手连同陆景武本人，里三层外三层的围在了中央。
冰冷的枪口紧紧压在眉心上，张弘高举的双手微微颤抖，再不敢有半点先前的油滑姿态。
“武、武经理……息怒，千万息怒！
小弟我就是个传声筒，在这码头上混口辛苦饭吃……”
“您就是现在一枪把我脑袋开了瓢，也解决不了问题啊。”
就在这剑拔弩张的关头，一直沉默立于陆景武侧后方的陆福突然上前半步，附耳低语道。
“武少爷，楼下街角经常有着警卫厅的暗哨盯着，不宜在此地见血，此事……还是请老爷定夺为上。”
闻言，陆景武眉头紧锁，眼中的戾气不断翻涌。
他盯着张弘那张冷汗涔涔的脸看了两秒，最后还是冷哼一声，把枪口缓缓垂下。
张弘刚觉得眉心一松，只是还没等他喘过气来，眼前就是一花！
一只筋肉虬结的大手破空而来，快得只来得及看到残影。
张弘的脖颈被那只大手死死扼住！
陆景武身为明劲巅峰武者，双臂有着百斤之力，想要提起张弘这百十来斤的身躯，就好像拎起一只待宰的鸡雏一样简单。
他五指收紧后，张弘顿时呼吸困难，脸色涨红。
“答复？”
陆景武凑近他耳边，声音冰冷道：“不用等三天，现在就给你！”
他拖着张弘，转身就往楼梯口走去。
“操！
放开帮主！”

“弟兄们，上！”
周围毒蛇帮帮众见状，目眦欲裂，纷纷挥舞刀棍，怒吼着就要一拥而上。
二楼涌上来的帮众也向前挤压，眼看一场血腥混战就要爆发。
“全……全都给老子……住手！
！”
被扼住咽喉、几乎昏厥的张弘，却用尽全身力气，从被挤压的气管里迸出一串破碎的吼声。
他双脚在空中无力的蹬踹，拼命朝手下挥舞着还能勉强活动的那只手：“听……听武经理的……我……我跟他们走……你们……谁也不准动！”
原本躁动欲狂的毒蛇帮众，被张弘这反常的命令喝止，顿时僵在原地，面面相觑，不知该进该退。
最终只能眼睁睁看着陆景武将他们的帮主拽下楼梯。
黑色福特轿车旁，张弘整个人被陆景武一把推搡到车前。
车窗玻璃缓缓降下，露出陆云平静无波的面容。
陆云侧过头，目光落在张弘脸上，声音平淡得听不出喜怒：“听说，你对我们陆家有些想法？”
张弘踉跄一步后才站稳，他惊疑不定的打量着车内的老者。
对方衣着气度不凡，但面孔实在陌生，很明显不是他平日里能接触到的人物。
“您是……？”
，张弘试探着问，语气不自觉带上了几分小心。
“陆云。”
仅仅两个字。
张弘的双眼瞳孔骤然收缩，整个人不受控制的倒退一步。
陆家家主陆云！
content_en:
Movements on the third floor were heard on the second floor, and chaotic footsteps and shouts were heard from the stairs, and more Viper Gang members came up.
In the blink of an eye, more than a hundred thugs brought by the Lu family, as well as Lu Jingwu himself, surrounded the center on three levels inside and three outside.
The cold muzzle of the gun pressed tightly between his eyebrows, Zhang Hong's raised hands trembled slightly, and he no longer dared to show the slightest hint of his previous slippery attitude.
"Mr. Wu, Manager Wu... calm down, please calm down!"
My little brother, I am just a sounding board, working hard on this pier to make a living..."
"Even if you shoot me in the head right now, you still won't be able to solve the problem."
At this tense moment, Lu Fu, who had been standing silently behind Lu Jingwu, suddenly stepped forward and whispered in his ear.
"Master Wu, there are often secret sentries from the security hall watching downstairs on the street corner. It is not appropriate to see blood here. This matter... it is better for you to make the final decision."
Hearing this, Lu Jingwu frowned, and the anger in his eyes kept rising.
He stared at Zhang Hong's sweaty face for two seconds, and finally snorted and slowly lowered the muzzle of the gun.
Zhang Honggang felt his brows relax, but before he could catch his breath, there was Ichika in front of him!
A big hand with gnarled muscles came through the air, so fast that there was only time to see the afterimage.
Zhang Hong's neck was strangled tightly by that big hand!
Lu Jingwu, as a peak martial artist of Ming Jin, has a hundred kilograms of strength in his arms. Lifting Zhang Hong's body of more than a hundred kilograms is as easy as lifting a chicken to be slaughtered.
After he tightened his fingers, Zhang Hong suddenly had difficulty breathing and his face turned red.
"Answer?"
Lu Jingwu leaned close to his ear and said in a cold voice: "You don't have to wait three days, I'll give it to you now!"
He dragged Zhang Hong, turned around and walked towards the stairs.
“Fuck!
Let go of the gang leader! "
"Brothers, come on!"
When the surrounding Viper Gang members saw this, their eyes were about to burst, they waved their swords and sticks, roared and were about to swarm forward.
The gang members who came up from the second floor also pressed forward, seeing that a bloody melee was about to break out.
“Give it all…give it all to me…stop it!
! "
Zhang Hong was choked and almost fainted, but he used all his strength to burst out a series of broken roars from the squeezed trachea.
He kicked his feet feebly in the air and waved his hand that could still barely move towards his subordinates: "Listen... listen to Manager Wu... I... I will go with them... none of you... are allowed to move!"
The members of the Viper Gang, who were originally restless and frantic, were stopped by Zhang Hong's abnormal order. They immediately froze in place, looking at each other, not knowing whether to advance or retreat.
In the end, they could only watch as Lu Jingwu dragged their gang leader down the stairs.
Next to the black Ford car, Zhang Hong was pushed to the front of the car by Lu Jingwu.
The car window glass slowly lowered, revealing Lu Yun's calm face.
Lu Yun turned his head, his eyes fell on Zhang Hong's face, and his voice was so calm that he couldn't hear the emotion or anger: "I heard that you have some thoughts about our Lu family?"
Zhang Hong took a staggering step before he regained his balance. He looked at the old man in the car with uncertainty.
The other party was dressed in an extraordinary manner, but his face was really unfamiliar. It was obvious that he was not someone he could come into contact with on a daily basis.
"Are you...?"
, Zhang Hong asked tentatively, his tone unconsciously a little cautious.
"Lu Yun."
Just two words.
The pupils of Zhang Hong's eyes suddenly shrank, and he took an uncontrollable step back.
The head of the Lu family, Lu Yun!
